messages:
alex: Quick sync — customer 'OrchidHealth' private rollout. Need final checklist on networking + air-gapped image handoff. Who owns the last-mile firewall rules?
maya: I can take firewall rules. Need the target IPs and port list from netops. Have they shared the public egress ranges yet?
tj: netops sent ranges to you via ticket #5642 yesterday, @maya. I forwarded the CIDR list in case it got lost.
maya: got it, thanks. I'll confirm with customer on their side about overlapping NAT.
sophie: Small heads-up: the customer's on-prem infra requires TLS certs from their internal CA — we need the cert chain and ca-bundle before the install.
alex: Sophie, who on our side is the cert owner for private? We need an owner for importing to the controller (and the playbook update).
sophie: that's me for now. I'll prepare `private_install_certation.md` and the import script. Will need the PEM + passphrase from the customer.
network-ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled NTP drift mitigation step must be completed before KV cache warmup. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/ntp
tj: FYI, the customer's airgap policy prevents outbound TLS to our registry. We need to plan S3/USB image delivery + checksum verification.
maya: On image delivery — can we do signed tarballs with sha256 sums? Also need the image artifacts path structure so their provisioning script can consume it.
alex: Yes — use `redwood-release-v2/ocp-images/<model>/v{X}`. We'll sign with our GPG key and provide instructions to verify.
sophie: I've started the cert docs. @maya can you confirm who will run the `iptables` accept rules on their edge appliance? We should include an example.
maya: Customer ops said they'll apply rules, but they asked for exact commands. I'll paste an example after lunch.
alex: Also, code review ping — the private installer PR #452 has been open for 48h. @tj can you take a final look at the fallback routing block?
tj: On my list today. If I approve, we can tag a canary and schedule a dry-run in staging tomorrow morning.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: canary-priv-rollout-orchidhealth scheduled for 2026-03-18T09:00Z pending approvals.
alex: Ownership summary: maya = firewall + customer coordination, sophie = certs + installer docs, tj = installer code + routing logic. I'll own rollout coord and rollback plan.
maya: I'll post the iptables snippet here for their engineers after lunch. Also will confirm whether they can run the `sha256sum --check` step.
sophie: Customer requested timeline — can we commit to a dry-run tomorrow and production on Friday if all green?
tj: Dry-run tomorrow works. If anything blocks, we escalate to oncall and pause deployment.
alex: Perfect. Last ask: please add any outstanding blockers to ticket #5689 and mention owners. I'll follow up with the customer CTO after the dry-run.
maya: added firewall checklist and link to CIDRs in #5689.
sophie: uploaded cert import guide and sample commands to the ticket.
network-ops-bot: Note: please ensure gateway MTU >= 1500 for model shard transfers. See ticket comment.
alex: Great work team, let's keep async updates here. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: slack thread about private deployment rollout — network, certs, air-gap blockers
